description: Nomination and Declaration Form for adding or changing nominees under the Employees' Provident Fund and Employees' Pension Scheme.

fields.name: Account Number / UAN
fields.description: Your Universal Account Number (UAN) from EPFO, or your account number assigned by the employer.

fields.name: Name of Employee
fields.description: Your full name as it appears in your Aadhaar card/PAN.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Father's name if unmarried, or husband's name if married — for identification.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Name of Establishment & Address
fields.description: Full name and address of your employer/factory.

fields.name: Nominee Name
fields.description: Full legal name of your nominee as per their Aadhaar or ID.

fields.name: Nominee Address
fields.description: Complete residential address of the nominee including PIN code.

fields.name: Nominee Relationship
fields.description: Your relationship to the nominee: Wife/Son/Daughter/Father/Mother etc.

fields.name: Nominee Date of Birth
fields.description: Nominee's date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format — required for minors.

fields.name: PF Share Amount for Nominee
fields.description: Amount or percentage of PF to be paid to this nominee on member's death.

fields.name: EPS Nominee Name
fields.description: Name of nominee for Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) — can differ from PF nominee.

fields.name: Family Member Details
fields.description: List all family members eligible if you have a family. Include name, relation, and date of birth.

fields.name: Witness Signature
fields.description: Signature of a witness (not the nominee) who is also an employee of the establishment.

fields.name: Employee Signature with Date
fields.description: Your signature and date confirming that the nomination is true and voluntary.
